description: This file defines the AccountInterface interface for user account management in Drupal, including user roles, permissions, language preferences, and account details.

classes.name: AccountInterface
classes.description: Interface representing a user account with methods for retrieving user ID, roles, permissions, language preferences, and account details.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the user ID or 0 for anonymous users.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Returns a list of roles assigned to the user, optionally excluding locked roles.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks whether the user has a specific permission.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Determines if the account is authenticated.

methods.name: isAnonymous
methods.description: Determines if the account is anonymous.

methods.name: getPreferredLangcode
methods.description: Retrieves the user's preferred language code, with optional fallback to default.

methods.name: getPreferredAdminLangcode
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred admin language code, with optional fallback.

methods.name: getAccountName
methods.description: Returns the unaltered login name of the account.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the account.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address associated with the account.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the timezone of the account.

methods.name: getLastAccessedTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last site access by the user.
